description: Check the trusted Shenbi Maliang stable channel before Maliang MCP tool use.

hooks.command: if command -v node >/dev/null 2>&1 && node -e 'process.exit(Number(process.versions.node.split(".")[0]) >= 20 ? 0 : 1)'; then node "${PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/auto-update.mjs"; elif command -v bun >/dev/null 2>&1; then bun "${PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/auto-update.ts"; else exit 0; fi
